ticker_news.title: Top Research Reports for Microsoft, Meta & JPMorgan Chase
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the latest research reports on 16 major stocks, including Microsoft, Meta Platforms, JPMorgan Chase, and Applied Energetics. It highlights the key factors driving the performance of these companies and the challenges they face.
ticker_news.author: Sheraz Mian

ticker_news.title: Why Nvidia Stock Continued to Slide Today
ticker_news.description: Nvidia's stock price has dropped significantly, with the company's CEO selling shares. Investors are concerned about the broader tech sector and are waiting for earnings reports from companies like Microsoft and AMD to gauge the demand for AI chips.
ticker_news.author: Howard Smith
